title: Zesty Poached Mediterranean Fish Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy bowl dish featuring poached fish, brightened with lemon and topped with olives, capers, and sun-dried tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Packed in oil, drained, and chopped

instructions: Fill a large saucepan with water, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low, and add the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper to the water.
Add the salmon fillet to the saucepan, and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the salmon from the water with a slotted spoon, and transfer to a plate.
Add the chopped parsley, olives, artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes to the saucepan.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the vegetables are heated through.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the cooked vegetables on a plate, followed by a portion of the poached salmon.
Drizzle with additional lemon juice, if desired, and serve immediately.
